newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed up on export demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed up on export demand.

text.p: Speculative demand triggered by lower arrivals and fresh export enquiries pushed castorseed higher on Tuesday, dealers said.
The December delivery contract rose 7-8 rupees to 1,149/1,150 per quintal.
"Shippers are short and they are covering their positions," one operator said.
Groundnut oil rose 3.0 rupees to 435/436 per 10 kg on renewed physical buying ahead of approaching festivals coupled with thin inflow of 40/50 tonnes.
In Rajkot spot oil rose to 705/710 rupees per 15 kg from 695/700.
